page_title: OVI 0-2 LEV | Oviedo v Levante 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Jose Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' R. Oviedo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' Matias Moreno (Levante) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' The ball is out of play and R. Oviedo manage to earn a corner.
87' R. Oviedo have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Julian Calero has decided to substitute Etta Eyong and he is replaced by Goduine Koyalipou (Levante).
84' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
83' A substitution has been made. Leander Dendoncker is replaced by Alex Fores (R. Oviedo).
82' Matias Moreno (Levante) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
82' Levante control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
80' Julian Calero has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Victor Garcia (Levante) replacing Carlos Alvarez.
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ivan Romero will be replaced by Jose Morales (Levante).
79' Rahim Alhassane (R. Oviedo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
76' Rahim Alhassane (R. Oviedo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
76' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:5.
74' Substitution. Oviemuno Ejaria (R. Oviedo) on for Santiago Colombatto.
72' 0 - 2 Goal! Etta Eyong (Levante) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
72' Now Levante have a corner.
71' David Carmo (R. Oviedo) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Jose Munuera lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
66' Julian Calero decides to make a substitution. Unai Vencedor will be replaced by Oriol Rey (Levante).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Roger Brugue leaves the pitch and Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) comes on.
66' R. Oviedo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
64' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
63' Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' The ball goes out of play and Levante have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Veljko Paunovic has decided to make a change. Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) replaces Salomon Rondon.
58' The manager makes a subsitution with Santi Cazorla (R. Oviedo) coming on for Alberto Reina.
57' Manu Sanchez (Levante) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and R. Oviedo will have a goal kick.
57' Aaron Escandell (R. Oviedo) sends an accurate short pass. David Carmo controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
53' The R. Oviedo players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
51' Levante are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
48' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Veljko Paunovic probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Josip Brekalo. He is replaced by Ilyas Chaira (R. Oviedo).
46' The whistle blows and Jose Munuera starts the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
45+1' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Roger Brugue (Levante) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Aaron Escandell.
43' Manu Sanchez (Levante) extricates himself from the difficult situation with a good pass, comfortably eluding the pressing opponent.
40' A spell of possession for R. Oviedo in an attempt to control the game.

38' Ivan Romero (Levante) gets in a header from the resulting free kick. It lacks accuracy, however, to bother the keeper and the ball goes a few metres wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and R. Oviedo will have a goal kick.
36' 50:50 – the latest ball possession ratio.
33' Levante are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
32' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from R. Oviedo.
30' 0 - 1 Goal! Carlos Alvarez (Levante) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Manu Sanchez, then sends ball into the top left corner. 0:1.
30' Manu Sanchez (Levante) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
29' Levante try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
27' Rahim Alhassane (R. Oviedo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Munuera saw the whole situation.
26' Ivan Romero (Levante) leaps highest to meet a cross and steers a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper produces a crucial save to thwart the effort.
24' Levante have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
24' A lofted cross from Manu Sanchez (Levante) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Levante have a corner.
23' Levante seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
21' R. Oviedo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
19' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Rahim Alhassane darts into free space to control the ball.
17' Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
17' Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) is penalised for holding. Jose Munuera signals a set piece.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from R. Oviedo comes to nothing.
12' Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
11' The Levante players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
9' Manu Sanchez (Levante) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

7' Salomon Rondon (R. Oviedo) is inside the box in a promising position to head home! His poor header flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
5' R. Oviedo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' R. Oviedo have been awarded a corner kick.
2' The Levante players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Levante will take the kick-off.
Jose Munuera is the one to supervise the game today.
